title: After the Kikuka Sho: Bouncing Back

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser is disappointed after losing. All the same, she still shows everyone that she's as optimistic as ever for next time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, in the runners' tunnel, Rice Shower and Mihono Bourbon exchange compliments and promise to have a rematch in their senior year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After returning to campus, Matikanetannhauser sets the spring Tenno Sho as her next major goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She wants to run another long-distance race between now and spring, so we set the Diamond Stakes as her next race!
